name: visio-scientific-illustrator
description: Draw editable scientific figures live inside Microsoft Visio through a local COM bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Draw editable scientific figures live inside Microsoft Visio.
interface.longDescription: Controls only a plugin-owned Microsoft Visio process through a local C# COM bridge. Rich text, native paths, scientific components, SceneGraphs, editable shapes, images, glued connectors, groups, layers, containers, layout, and ShapeSheet-safe styling appear step by step in the visible Visio window. The plugin compiles draw.io blueprints, compares regional previews, safely saves VSDX files, and validates structural fidelity through an independent hidden file mode.
